Maya: Okay team — quick (awesome) announcement: we crossed $5,000,000 ARR today. All in. :tada: :sparkles:
Samir: WHAT!!! :scream: massive congrats y'all :rocket:
Jordan: Incredible. Huge shoutout to sales & infra. This is everyone’s win. :clap:
Lee: Drinks on me next time we're all together 🍻 or I will ship snacks globally if remote :package:

Samir: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/confetti-happy-IU5r1k1n1 (post)
celebrate-bot: :confetti_ball: Automated confetti deployed in #random (1,000 confetti pieces)

Maya: Poll: cake wins by default but swag for remote folks is fine. Vote!
Lee: 1 — cake. Also can we have a '5M ARR' sticker for laptops?
Emily: 2 — remote swag pls (I am biased, I live in snackland)

Maya: Noted. Action items: Emily -> cake + remote swag coord; Vincent -> stickers design + print quote; Jordan -> organize a quick all-hands shoutout tomorrow 10am PT.
Lee: Can we get a tiny celebratory slack emoji? :redwood-hype: (jk, but that would be sick)

Vincent: High fives all around. :raised_hands:
Samir: Midnight champagne GIF incoming. :champagne:
